content.text:
I added one new shortcut: `/` now jumps to the search box, unless you're already typing in a field. The other two already worked: Enter in the todo box adds the todo, and Escape cancels an edit. I found and fixed one bug, but I did not run the app; the only test was a syntax check of the script. The checks folder is empty, so no earlier feature has an automated test.

- **Bug fixed:** if you left the tab mid-edit and came back, the edit box lost focus, so Enter, Escape and clicking away did nothing. The edit box now gets focus back after every redraw. My review of the rest turned up nothing else broken, and all rules in force still hold.
- **Rejected:** a separate Enter handler on the todo box, because it would add the todo twice.
